scripts.electron:pack: npm run build && node electron/copy-web-dist.js && electron-builder --dir
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && node electron/copy-web-dist.js && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.lint: eslint web/src electron vite.config.js eslint.config.js tests/web tests/electron
scripts.test:integration: node tests/language.cjs && node tests/http-server.cjs && node tests/page-lifetime.cjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write web/src electron vite.config.js eslint.config.js tests/web tests/electron
